tasks.title: Multi Media Test
tasks.statement:
Edit:
Joop van der Schee
Luc Zwartjes
                     2012 Cologne, Germany

                                                            INSTRUCTIONS

Look at every page and read the questions carefully.

This multi media test has 30 questions. You have 45 minutes to complete the
test. If you are ready wait silently untill the 45 minutes are over.

Each question is multiple-choice. Choose A, B, C or D. Only one answer is
correct.
Some questions contain a short video clip (indicated with   ). Click inside the
video frame to start it.

Mark your choice on the Answer Sheet by making a circle around the letter that
you want to select. If you make a mistake cross out the selected letter and
circle a new choice.

For navigation it is best to use the arrows   on the keyboard to move to
the next page. Do not click on the escape button, as that ends the presentation.

Good luck!

                                                           • Question 1

Based on the information in this picture, in which direction away from
Amsterdam was this plane flying?

A. North
B. South
C. East
D. West

                                                              Photo: Jussi Mestari

                           • Question 2

Where was this picture
taken?

A. 35°S in Africa
B. 35°S in Australia
C. 60°S in South America
D. 60°N in Europe

                              photo: Jussi Mestari

                                        • Question 3

The map shows worldwide production of

A. Grapes
B. Wheat
C. Rice
D. Cotton

          Question 4

What is the main rock
of this landform?

A. Basalt
B. Tuff
C. Limestone
D. Granite

                                • Question 5

E       W   Which of the figures explains the
            phenomenon of clouds in the mountains
            as shown on the photograph?
    A
            A, B, C or D ?

    B

    C

    D

                                                             • Question 6

Which two islands are main areas of cultivation for the depicted crop:

A. Sri Lanka
   and Java
B. Midway
   and Mauritius
C. The Azores
   and Sumatra
D. Hokkaido
   and New Guinea

                                                             • Question 7

The picture shows Yverdon-les-Bains in Switzerland (46°46.71′ N and
6°38.45′E). It was taken on 21th March 2012. In which direction in the cyclist
heading?

A.ESE
B.WNW
C.ENE
D.WSW

                         • Question 8

With what stage of the
demographic transition
does this population
histogram correspond?

A. Stage 1
B. Stage 2
C. Stage 3
D. Stage 4

                                                           • Question 9

We leave Sydney in the indicated direction. Which city will we reach after
32.200 km:

 A. Singapore
 B. Paris
 C. Tokyo
 D. New York

                                                     • Question 10

The photo shows a building in Jakarta constructed by the Dutch.
Remnants from colonial times can still be seen in many countries.
For which country is this not true?

A. Thailand
B. Canada
C. Laos
D. Libya

                                    • Question 11

In what country were these photos
taken?

A. Cape Verde
B. Cuba
C. Tonga
D. Sri Lanka

                                                     • Question 12

What does this world map show the distribution of?
A. Total number of internet connections
B. Medals won at the 2010 Beijing Olympics
C. Total numbers of tourist arrivals
D. Number of dentists per thousand population

       • Question 13

Which city has the same type
of road network as Moscow?

A. Kyoto
B. Cairo
C. Paris
D. Chicago

    • Question 14

Red/blue circles on this
map indicate the location
of severe damage
caused by a type of
natural hazard in 2008-
2010.
This hazard was:

A. Earthquakes
B. Mud flows
C. Floods
D. Tsunamis

                                       • Question 15

This early 21st century
world map shows
the geographical
distribution of :

A.   Average life expectancy
B.   GDP (Gross Domestic Production)
C.   Literacy
D.   Primary education

                                                                 • Question 16

Which words are missing in the text
below?
A. 1 = climate change and
   2 = is not broken down
B. 1= wave pattern and
   2 = accumulates
C. 1 = rotation of the earth and
   2 = accumulates
D. 1 = distance to the equator and
   2 = is not broken down

 The oceans are dynamic systems, made up of complex networks of currents that keep
 water circulating around the World. The direction of the currents is determined by wind,
 variations in water density and ……………………(1). Sometimes this creates ocean
 currents that take on enormous circular motion. These are called gyres. Due to the
 deflection of ocean currents at the centre of the gyre, plastic debris
 .……………………………. (2).

                               • Question 17

The central feature in
this photo was
formed by:

A. Erosion of a ring dyke
B. Impact of a meteorite
C. Volcanic eruption
D. Uplift of a concave slope

                            • Question 18

The Cabinet of which
island country
held an underwater
meeting to draw attention
to the threat of rising
sea level submerging
their country?

A. Maldives
B. Fiji
C. Malta
D. Iceland

                                     • Question 19

There are two landlocked countries
in South America, but only one of
them has a capital that cannot be
reached by ship from the ocean.
Which country is it?

A. Peru
B. Bolivia
C. Paraguay
D. Uruguay

                                         • Question 20

Here are three models characterizing
the development of urban processes.
This reduction of complexity allows an
easier analysis of urban forms. Look
carefully. Which name does not refer
to one of these three models?

A. Concentric model
(after Burgess)
B. Sector model
(after Hoyt)
C. Multiple nuclei model
(after Harris and
Ullman)
D. Multiple segment
model (after Lloyd)

                  • Question 21

Which country’s
data makes the
blue line?

A.Spain
B.Indonesia
C.Ecuador
D.Botswana

                                                         • Question 22

This satellite picture
shows the volcanic
Galapagos Islands.
Which of the following
statements is correct?

A.The island of Isabela is older than Santa Fé.
B.The island of San Cristobal is younger than Fernandina.
C.The island of Isabela is younger than the island of Espanola.
D.The island of Espanola is younger than the island of Isabela.

                                                         • Question 23

Which natural product is native to Ethiopia, but was a
commercial success in South America?

A. Coffee
B. Cocoa
C. Orange
D. Tea

                      • Question 24

This film zooms out
from which city?

A.Chicago
B.Montreal
C.New York
D.Toronto

                                 • Question 25

The map shows a
population growth rate
of over 2% for
Sub-Saharan Africa.
What is the reason for
the zero growth rate in
South Africa?

A. Improved level of education
B. High standard of living
C. HIV pandemic
D. Climate change

                                                        • Question 26

Forest fires in
Mediterranean countries
like Portugal are
often caused by:

A. Strong winds coming from the Atlantic Ocean
B. People who set fire to areas on purpose or accidentally
C. Spontaneous ignition when there is a combination of high temperatures
   and dry weather in the summer
D. Sparks coming from passing cars

                                           • Question 27

Which word is missing in the text below?
   A. Spring
   B. Monsoon
   C. Snow melt
   D. Autumn
The Tonle Sap remains relatively
small for most of the year, measuring
about a metre in depth and covering
around 2,700 km2.
However, the river connected to the
lake starts to swell during the
…………… season as water that flows
from the Mekong River reverses,
helping to expand the Tonle Sap to an
area of up to 16,000 km2 with a depth
of up to 9 metres.

                                                      • Question 28

On Saturday June 30th, 2012, UNESCO condemned the destruction of
three sacred tombs by Islamic militants who said they would destroy more.
In which country was this destruction?

 A. Niger
 B. Chad
 C. Mali
 D. Yemen

                         • Question 29

In which city was this
photo taken?

A. Chicago
B. Miami
C. New Orleans
D. San Francisco

                                                • Question 30

Walls and fences are everywhere in the world.
Where were these pictures taken?

A. 1 = Belfast, 2 = Tijuana, 3 = Paju                      1
B. 1 = Paju,    2 = Tijuana, 3 = Belfast
C. 1 = Paju,    2 = Belfast, 3 = Tijuana
D. 1 = Tijuana, 2 = Paju,    3 = Belfast

                                  2                       3

                                                         • The End

You reached the last slide of the multi media test.

Click on the arrow  to go back to the previous page(s) if you want
to check your answers.

Or close Adobe Reader.
